integrity: Exact algebraic argument and a standalone finite rational-arithmetic verifier are included.
scientific_limitations: First-order stochastic order is pointwise for one leaf event, not multivariate leaf conditioning. Aggregate Eulerian-Stirling results predate the work; positional historical priority may be incomplete. Finite checker supports but does not prove generality.
title: Rank-resolved stochastic ordering of minimum-key depth by leaves in uniform binary search trees
